sloka: महाबलो महावीर्यो राक्षसैः बहुभिः वृतः ।श्रूयते च महाराजा रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ॥१-२०-१७॥
transliteration: mahābalo mahāvīryo rākṣasaiḥ bahubhiḥ vṛtaḥ ।śrūyate ca mahārājā rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ ॥1-20-17॥

translations.english: Ravana, king of rakshasas, is the brother of Kubera and son of ascetic Visravana. He is said to possess great prowess.
